name: Document convert
description: Turns Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OpenDocument files into PDFs with LibreOffice on this computer, and reads the plain text out of a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx without it. It does not edit documents, convert to any format but PDF, or read PDFs, and making a PDF needs LibreOffice installed.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.convert_to_pdf: Turn a document (Word .docx, Excel .xlsx, PowerPoint .pptx, .odt, .ods, .odp, .txt or .md) into a PDF with LibreOffice on this computer, and say where the PDF is.
tools.read_document_text: Read the plain text out of a Word .docx, Excel .xlsx or PowerPoint .pptx (or a .txt or .md) without changing it.
tools.list_converted: List the PDFs this tool has made, newest first.

convert_to_pdf: turn this Word document into a PDF
make a PDF of my spreadsheet
read_document_text: read me what is in this Word doc

setup_steps.title: Install LibreOffice
setup_steps.why: Making a PDF uses LibreOffice, a free office suite, on this computer. Reading text out of a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx works without it.

consent: Your files stay on this computer: LibreOffice on this computer converts them, and the PDFs are kept in this tool's own data folder (made). It does not use the internet.
